traits.habitat_notes: Exposed freshwater pond shores, seepage bogs and fens, interdunal swales, coastal peat bogs, wet borrow pits; Atlantic Coastal Plain (FNA).

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form chosen from the plant's habit: a tuft of erect thread-like leaves 10-25 cm long, unrolling like fern croziers, densely covered in red-purple tentacles each tipped with a clear drop, with a scape of pink-purple flowers.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species.

allometry.note: 0.25 m tall at 3 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: a tuft of erect thread-like leaves 10-25 cm long, unrolling like fern croziers, densely covered in red-purple tentacles each tipped with a clear drop, with a scape of pink-purple flowers.

traits.library_form.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): a small perennial rosette herb: forb.

traits.life_span.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs perennial.

traits.woodiness.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs.

traits.leaf_habit.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): plants form winter hibernaculae (Wikipedia: a bud of tightly curled leaves at ground level); the summer rosette dies back.

traits.rosette.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves basal, dense, long-petiolate.

traits.cauline_leaves.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): scapes 5-35 cm, glabrous (leafless).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): scapes 6-26 cm; leaves 8-25(-30) cm, usually overtopping or equalling the scape.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): leaves to 30 cm.

traits.crown_width_max_m.note: A model estimate: FNA's rosettes are 1 cm across, but the erect thread leaves to 30 cm lean apart a little: 12 cm.

traits.stem_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): stem base bulbous-cormose, composed of expanded petiole bases, 1-2 cm, woolly.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves basal and rosulate (spirally set).

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): rosulate basal leaves; spiral as in the order's default.

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): leaves erect.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): blade filiform, 8-25(-30) cm x 1 mm (the library's narrowest outline, linear); Darwin p.281: 'thread-like'.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): blade filiform, 8-25(-30) cm; the petiole not differentiated from the blade.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): blade 1 mm wide.

traits.leaf_margin.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blades unlobed; margin fringed only by the stalked glands.

traits.stipules.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stipules adnate to the petiole for their whole length, 4-6 mm, fringed along the distal half; FOC 5-7-fid, 6-8 mm, scarious.

traits.glandular_hairs.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaf blades with red, long, capitate, sticky glandular hairs; Wikipedia: the upper surface densely covered.

traits.glandular_hair_length_m.note: A model estimate: Darwin p.281: the tentacles on the leaf's convex upper face are 'short'; their length is D. intermedia's central tentacles' (0.46-0.91 mm, Kozak et al. 2026).

traits.hair_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): trichomes red to reddish purple, drying dark brown.

traits.leaf_colour.note: A model estimate: FNA (genus) gives leaves red in strong sun and greener in shade; the thread leaf is green under its dense red tentacles, so an olive green.

traits.vernation.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): juvenile leaf blade circinate.

traits.inflorescence.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): cincinni 1 or 2, 3-30-flowered (one-sided coiled cymes); Wikipedia: flowers on one side of a single slender stalk.

traits.inflorescence_posture.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences erect, scapiform, slender.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences 4-12(-24)-flowered.

traits.peduncle_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): scapes 6-26 cm, glabrous.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: the coiled flowering tip of the scape uncurls to about 2-6 cm with its 2-15 flowers on 1-3 mm pedicels.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pedicels 1-3 mm.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): flowers 10-20 mm diam.

traits.flower_merosity.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals 5, petals 5 (Wikipedia five-petalled).

traits.perianth.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals 5, petals 5.

traits.sepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): sepals oblong to elliptic, 4-7 x 2-2.5 mm, glandular-pilose.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): petals 7-10(-12) x 5-15 mm.

traits.petal_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): petals pink to purple-lavender, broadly ovate, apical margins erose; the widest part toward the tip (obovate) as in the flower's photographs (inferred).

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): petals pink to purple-lavender.

traits.calyx_colour.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals green, glandular; sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.stamens.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens 5, 4-5 mm.

traits.stamen_length_m.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens 4-5 mm.

traits.carpels.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): placentas 3; styles 3 or 4, deeply parted.

traits.fruit_type.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsules 5 mm.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): capsules 5-6 mm.

traits.capsule_valves.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsule 3- or 4-valved.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: a ripe dry capsule pale brown, inside the persistent withered sepals and petals; sRGB by eye.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): flowering late May-Sep.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate: flowering (FNA late May-Sep) shifted a month later; FNA gives no fruiting time.

traits.leaf_out_months.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: rosettes unfold from the hibernaculum in spring after snowmelt, April-May.

traits.leaf_fall_months.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: summer leaves die back as the hibernaculum forms in autumn, September-October.

traits.elevation_min_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): 0-40 m.

traits.elevation_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): 0-40 m.

traits.light.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves red in strong sunlight, greener in shade; FOC forest understories and wet sunny open areas.

traits.moisture.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): Sphagnum bogs, fens, swamps, wet sand, seeps.

traits.soil_texture.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): peaty gravels, sandy soil, wet sand (peat, the commonest substrate, has no state).

traits.habitat_notes.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): exposed freshwater pond shores, seepage bogs and fens, interdunal swales, coastal peat bogs, wet borrow pits.

traits.flowering_stems.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Wikipedia, Drosera rotundifolia (read 2026-10-19): a single flowering stalk from the centre of the rosette.

traits.fruit_seed_length_m.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): seeds 1-1.5 mm, fusiform.

traits.fruit_seed_colour.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): seeds light brown with a metallic sheen; sRGB by eye for 'light brown'.

traits.marginal_gland_length_m.note: A model estimate: Darwin p.281: 'those on the margins being the longest and reflexed'; no measurement found, set from the longest of D. intermedia's marginal tentacles (to 3.2 mm, Kozak et al. 2026) and a little beyond.

traits.glandular_hairs_per_cm2.note: A model estimate: no count found; a thread leaf 8-25 cm by 1 mm (FNA) densely covered (FNA 'blade densely covered with trichomes'), about 300 to 1,500 tentacles on 1.7 square centimetres: 550 to the square centimetre.

traits.gland_head_diameter_m.note: A model estimate: as round-leaved sundew's glands (Darwin p.6, 0.20 mm long); none measured for D. filiformis.

traits.gland_head_shape.note: A model estimate: as round-leaved sundew's glands, oval (Darwin p.6); no shape described for D. filiformis.

traits.marginal_gland_head_shape.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Darwin, Insectivorous Plants (1875), p.6-7: the glands of the extreme marginal tentacles are elongated, unlike the oval glands of the disc.

traits.disc_gland_stalk_colour.note: As for round-leaved sundew, no other value having been found for Drosera filiformis: Darwin, Insectivorous Plants (1875), p.4-5: the pedicels of the short tentacles on the disc are green; the colour is the model's leaf green, a little darker.

traits.gland_drop_diameter_m.note: A model estimate: Darwin, Insectivorous Plants (1875), p.4: the glands 'are surrounded by large drops of extremely viscid secretion, which, glittering in the sun, have given rise to the plant's poetical name of the sun-dew'; p.13: it 'appears colourless'. Its width is a model estimate, 1.5 to 3 times the gland's (no measurement found).

traits.gland_secretion.note: Darwin, Insectivorous Plants (1875), p.13: a sundew's secretion 'appears colourless'.

traits.gland_stalk_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera filiformis (eFloras taxon 250101267, read 2026-10-19): trichomes red to reddish purple, drying dark brown.
